about: Hand-written comprehension questions for a few files of the recorded Docket snapshot (modules/arena/test/fixtures/docket-recorded.json: chd.lu dossier 8752, Esch-sur-Alzette council of 2 October 2026, points 6.1 and 7.1). Each answer quotes the file's own text word for word; tests check every quote against that snapshot, and the app drops any question whose quote is not in the live file. Written by the Arena builder; not yet signed off by advocates of each side. Prompts and options are in English, French and German. A seed question whose id matches a rule (about, agenda, vote) takes that rule's place.

prompt.en: According to its title, which area of law does this bill change?
prompt.fr: D'après son titre, quel domaine du droit ce projet de loi modifie-t-il ?
prompt.de: Welchen Rechtsbereich ändert dieser Gesetzentwurf laut seinem Titel?
